ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.

13. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

15. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.

18. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Dressing ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Care PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Care for PRACTICES be able to; and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Toileting PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Food/ PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Plants ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Animals ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
